wikipediaRead.title: Sheba
wikipediaRead.supportJa: 記事の表示題はShebaで、本文は古代南アラビアのSheba/Saba王国と領域を説明します。女王の地との同一性は断定しません。

primaryWitnesses.text: When the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon, she came to test Solomon with hard questions at Jerusalem, with a very great caravan, including camels that bore spices, gold in abundance, and precious stones. When she had come to Solomon, she talked with him about all that was in her heart.
primaryWitnesses.previousContext: Huram sent him ships and servants who had knowledge of the sea by the hands of his servants; and they came with the servants of Solomon to Ophir, and brought from there four hundred fifty talents of gold, and brought them to King Solomon.
primaryWitnesses.nextContext: Solomon answered all her questions. There wasn’t anything hidden from Solomon which he didn’t tell her.

primaryWitnesses.text: When the queen of Sheba had seen the wisdom of Solomon, the house that he had built,
primaryWitnesses.previousContext: Solomon answered all her questions. There wasn’t anything hidden from Solomon which he didn’t tell her.
primaryWitnesses.nextContext: the food of his table, the seating of his servants, the attendance of his ministers, their clothing, his cup bearers and their clothing, and his ascent by which he went up to the LORD’s house, there was no more spirit in her.

primaryWitnesses.text: She gave the king one hundred and twenty talents of gold, spices in great abundance, and precious stones. There was never before such spice as the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.
primaryWitnesses.previousContext: Blessed be the LORD your God, who delighted in you and set you on his throne to be king for the LORD your God, because your God loved Israel, to establish them forever. Therefore he made you king over them, to do justice and righteousness.”
primaryWitnesses.nextContext: The servants of Huram and the servants of Solomon, who brought gold from Ophir, also brought algum trees and precious stones.

primaryWitnesses.text: King Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatever she asked, more than that which she had brought to the king. So she turned and went to her own land, she and her servants.
primaryWitnesses.previousContext: The king used algum tree wood to make terraces for the LORD’s house and for the king’s house, and harps and stringed instruments for the singers. There were none like these seen before in the land of Judah.
primaryWitnesses.nextContext: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred sixty-six talents of gold,
